## Problem

Describe the user-visible diagnostic or maintenance problem.

## Change boundary

List the checks/files changed and anything intentionally left unchanged.

## Evidence

Link official documentation or reproducible public cases. Label community workarounds as community guidance.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant Pester tests pass
- [ ] PowerShell 5.1 syntax/behavior was considered
- [ ] PowerShell 7 syntax/behavior was considered
- [ ] PSScriptAnalyzer has no new warnings/errors
- [ ] JSON remains valid
- [ ] Issue report remains valid Markdown
- [ ] Disposable files are cleaned up
- [ ] No real secrets, credentials, cookies, auth files, or private reports were added
- [ ] README.zh-CN.md was updated if user-facing behavior changed

## Remaining limitations

State any uncertainty or unsupported environments. Use `UNKNOWN` in code when evidence cannot justify a stronger conclusion.
